utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m happy to help you figure out what to handle first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll start by checking the supplies and making sure we have enough on hand for Sunday. If anything’s missing, I’ll flag it right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — that’s a great first step, and I’ll help track down anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you send me the repair drive location and the best route there, Kira?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you need the repair drive location and route, right? I can send that over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please send the location and route over. Thanks — I’ll keep the details organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the time and place, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking on the missing pieces, but I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No rush — just send it when you have it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the first fix, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m still catching bits and pieces, so I’ll keep an ear out too. Just let me know when you hear what they’re fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — as soon as I hear the first thing they’re fixing, I’ll let you know and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I’m still in for the repair drive this week—send me the details and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’m a little behind, so what should I handle first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Start with the time and place, and send me any homes that need help. I’ll jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send over the homes that need repairs and any missing supplies right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — send them when you’re ready, and I’ll keep everything organized from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll get that list to you shortly, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Still on Saturday morning works for me — send me the time and I’ll coordinate the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the time soon and share the list, too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — once you send it, I’ll line everyone up and keep track of the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll sort the repair list by priority and check the latest details first, then I’ll pass along what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana. Let’s keep it simple and start with the repair list by priority.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll start with the highest-priority repairs and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — it’s this afternoon at the community shed. I’ll send the exact time and what to bring right now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — that helps a lot. I’m looking forward to pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great — I’ll text you the details in a minute. Thanks again for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still on for the repair drive this week, and I’ll keep spreading the word to anyone else who can help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — keep it going, and send me any new helpers or homes that need work.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll line up any new helpers I find and pass along homes that need work.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — could you hold off bringing them until Rosa confirms the timing? I just want to keep the logistics tidy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll hold off until Rosa confirms the timing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’ll wait on Rosa’s confirmation and then I’ll pass along the timing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring a few trash bags and check in at the community center desk first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — after the desk, please head to the supply table and help sort the cleanup gear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll head to the supply table after I check in and sort the cleanup gear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Still nothing new on the repair drive, but I’m keeping an ear out and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — just keep me posted, and I can jump in on whatever’s quickest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive, and I’ll let you know if anything comes up that’s quickest to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ve got the supplies tracked, and I’m keeping an eye on what still needs to be covered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still out running errands, so send me the list when you can and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll send you the current list and note what still needs covering for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help spread the word about the repair drive, and I’m happy to work around the school schedule. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — I’m thinking after school, around 3:30. I’ll confirm the final details and send them over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me — I’ll be ready to help at 3:30, and I can share the details once you send them over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — could you send me the repair drive location and the easiest route there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Head to the community center on Sunday — take Main Street, then turn by the library. That’s the easiest route.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — that’s perfect. I’ll head there Sunday via Main Street and the library turn.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — if Rosa’s set the time, could you send it over? I’m trying to line up the rest around it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can do that — once Rosa confirms the time, I’ll send it over so you can line up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks — once you hear from Rosa, just send me the time and I’ll keep everything lined up here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and point Rosa to the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate it. Send anyone who needs help my way, and I’ll keep the list and Sunday details organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll keep sending folks your way and make sure they have the Sunday details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve got the repair drive noted, and I’ll keep passing along the time and place once Mina confirms them with Ira.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring the gloves and flashlight. What time and place should I tell Ira?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Mina — please tell Ira it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll share the final time once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still good to help with the repair drive this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still good to help — I’m just a little behind on the details. What parts are still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—just to confirm, you can take on the repair drive help this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks, Leo. If Rosa or anyone else needs the location or easiest route, send them my way and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send Rosa any homes that need help and point folks to you for the route.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Leo — appreciate it. I’ll be ready with the location and route if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — I can help spread the word and I’ll keep an ear out for the time, place, and task.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Uli — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do — I’ll pass it along as soon as you send it. Thanks again, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Dane — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep — send me the remaining details, and I’ll jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great — I’ll send over the remaining details and let you know what still needs filling in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m still in for the repair drive this week. Just send me the time and place again, and I’ll show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send the time and place again, and I appreciate you being in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate it. Just send the time and place when you can, and I’ll be there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
